clauses.name: Stampeding Brood
clauses.printedParagraph: When Stampeding Brood enters the Empathic Vessel of an opponent, the owner of this card puts up to two tokens with 1 power {G} and Support in their Interzone. Those tokens are not lost at the Resolution.
clauses.expectedBehavior: The permanent Support token can be canceled while entering Support, retried, resolved, returned to Interzone after a win, and played again next turn.

clauses.name: Ignore
clauses.printedParagraph: Cancel a target effect on the stack unless its controller pays {H}{H}.
clauses.expectedBehavior: The payment choice cancels a target Token Support effect on the Stack when its controller declines.

clauses.name: Herbaceous Whisperer
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Herbaceous Whisperer is on the field, the manifestations in Support you control get +1 power.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Its +1 applies while the friendly token is actually in Support, not while that token waits in Interzone.

clauses.name: Gnarlipuff, the Slimy
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Gnarlipuff is in an opponent's Empathic Vessel, you can pay {H}{H}{H}: A target manifestation in that player's Interzone returns to the top of its owner's deck.
clauses.expectedBehavior: The owner can activate it from an opponent's Vessel; availability, auto-pass, declaration, payment and destination agree.

clauses.name: Rematch!
clauses.printedParagraph:
You can play Rematch! only during the Resolution, if you lost the confrontation.
All First Manifestations remain in the Confrontation Zone. Then, after the Resolution Phase, a new Confrontation Phase begins in the same turn.
clauses.expectedBehavior: The same-turn rematch preserves the recorded loss while restarting Reaction with both First Manifestations.

clauses.name: Recall
clauses.printedParagraph: If you lost the confrontation this turn, search your deck for a card. Reveal it and put it into your hand, then shuffle your deck.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Recall remains legal after a same-turn rematch because the prior confrontation loss is still authoritative.

limits: Selected transition branches only; no whole-card certification.
Reset is asserted as the final boundary but is not itself a printed card clause.
Browser playability remains covered by the separate client/server parity suite.
